steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Phew, run faster. I'll clear the way for you!

Finally, you reach the top of the spiral staircase, the only way out, and the Gate of Hell is recovering. You rush forward to grab the largest shard, and the sharp edge cuts through your hand as gravity pulls.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief?!
Although it isn't back to its original form, the broken mirror still shows your reflection. The figure then begins to twist into that familiar illusion of madness.

steps.speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Surrender...
Everyone, including you, feels an instinctive shudder.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: ...We can't just not be afraid of it... There's simply no way to control that fear.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: I don't get it... What do you want? Why come back?
Sosia's wicked laughter answers her. You pull the pale Lisa behind you.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Hehe... Trying to get out?

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Are you afraid of the coming unknown? Do you want to escape before the real horror starts? But where can you escape to?
She emerges from the chaos, approaching you with twisted power.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: The realm of fear is born, and will soon spread throughout the city. Nowhere will be safe... No one can escape fear, because there's no escaping reality.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Don't worry. I won't take your lives. Life is the source of fear, and the dead means nothing to me.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Start picturing what's worse than dying.

options: You're already making me tremble, Sosia.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I never wanted to run away!
You raise the Gate of Hell piece in your hand, break the bond of fear with all your might, and rush toward the witch who rules fear. The obsidian piece shows her reflection.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: This is?

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: You...?! Ahhhhhhh!!

The woman who created you said that works are the most sincere expression of the artist. You have to shed all the pretensions, bare your soul, and experience pain like never before to convey one-millionth of what is in your heart.
Let's see... The one who created Witching Hour, what kind of fear do you have inside?
A massive illusion breaks out of the mirror, roaring and charging at Sosia!

steps.speaker: Fear Shadow
steps.content: Great artist... Witch of fear... Tell your story... Feed me more fear...

steps.speaker: Fear Shadow
steps.content: What do you see and hear? What do you love and fear...

steps.speaker: Fear Shadow
steps.content: Say it and make it true. Come now. We are eager for your creation!

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Nooo!!
She screams and waves her hand to break the illusion in front of her, but the swarm of monsters within remains. They rush out as if sensing her fear, and you lose grasp of the piece.
The piece falls to the ground and is quickly dragged toward the Gate of Hell. With its last piece back, the gate is restored...
From the deep darkness, someone emerges—A man who mutters to himself.

steps.speaker: Black Illusion
steps.content: You... love me... So... give me... inspiration...

steps.speaker: Black Illusion
steps.content: Take me to the hall... Back to the pinnacle of... art... And show me once again... the truest fear...
With one step and another, he slowly walks toward Sosia with a hammer and a carving knife. And the dominating witch is petrified. She freezes in place just as you were.

steps.speaker: Black Illusion
steps.content: Yes, that's right... The perfect feeling. Feel the fear, you who love me! That's how you approach the reality of beauty and achieve the greatest art...

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: No... No...
Sosia begins to tremble as her power fades. The dark shadow starts absorbing her strength.
That's it. You bet on the slim chance and won. Only those who have been deeply afraid can create fear, and once captured by their fear, even Sosia will be robbed of her power by Witching Hour.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't just ******* stand there! There's a big guy over here!
Along with the dark illusion that grabbed Sosia, the "you" you have met earlier walks out.

steps.speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Surrender...

steps.speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Fear is making me stronger... You can't beat me...

steps.speaker: Crazed ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Bow down to me... Offer your fear... Become a part of me...
It's an illusion created by the Gate of Hell, a fear you can't deny. You can still feel its haunting power now.
But you beat it once, and you don't want to lose.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's see which one of us conquers our fear and this Witching Hour first.
